name: Jersey Devil
description: The Jersey Devil is a legendary winged, bipedal creature of the New Jersey Pine Barrens, traditionally said to be the cursed thirteenth child of 'Mother Leeds' born in 1735. Its most famous burst of activity was a week of mass sightings across South Jersey and Philadelphia in January 1909.

aliases.name: Leeds Devil
aliases.meaning: Earlier name connecting the legend to the Leeds family of colonial New Jersey

origin: The Jersey Devil is a distinctly regional cryptid associated with the Pine Barrens of southern New Jersey and adjacent areas of southeastern Pennsylvania and the Delaware Valley.
